description: Apps (add-ons) on a Lamoi site (serviceId from oma_waas_sites), the same list as the site's own Apps page. list (default): the site's plan, each app with kind (plugin, setting, action, service), the plan that includes it, whether it is on, what it needs, and how often the plan backs up. set (confirm; app from list, to on|off for plugins, set with value for settings such as analytics (GA4 id G-..., empty turns it off), run for actions such as legal (creates missing privacy, terms of sale and returns pages)). Apps above the site's plan are refused: change the plan first. Use it when a site needs a shop, payments, Posti pickup points, gift cards, analytics or legal pages.

app.description: set: app id from list (woocommerce, posti-shipping, lafu-gift-cards, analytics, legal...).

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

to.description: set: on/off for plugins, set (with value) for settings, run for actions.

value.description: set: the setting's value, e.g. a GA4 id G-XXXXXXX (empty turns it off).

name: oma_waas_apps
title: Lamoi site apps
